results.title: Hines Closes $591M Multifamily DST Offering, Its Largest to Date

brief.tension: The offering is backed by two multifamily properties sourced from Hines Global Income Trust (HGIT), a nontraded REIT. The tension is the transfer of assets from HGIT to the DST—essentially Hines moving properties from one vehicle to another to serve different investor bases, while HGIT retains a gross asset value of $7.29 billion and has been actively buying other properties. This internal reallocation raises questions about HGIT's disposition strategy and the performance expectations for the DST investors.
